summary: LocalSettings — settings for local filesystem and pre-mounted NFS/CIFS paths. ROOT_PATH is the base directory. Optional MOUNT_SPEC dict (mount_type, server, export_path, etc.) describes an NFS or CIFS share to mount before operations. Uses NoAuth. sdk_package=None (stdlib only).
lifecycle_notes: NFS/CIFS is handled via pre-mount: MOUNT_SPEC triggers mount, then uses the same LocalStorageBackend
documentation_hooks: Document that MOUNT_SPEC causes a mount operation before first access — this has side effects
examples: CLAUDE.md: LocalSettings(ROOT_PATH='/data', auth=NoAuth()) and NFS variant with MOUNT_SPEC
risks: Mount failures at LocalSettings init time produce errors that may be surprising

evidence.detail: Tests LocalSettings with and without MOUNT_SPEC
